eval_sim_specs.eval_engine: One engine: declared eval dataset in -> versioned result artifact out. Layers: data-quality, predictive, selection, market/execution, financial/quant (explicit clocks), statistical reliability, slices, operational, promotion pass/hold/fail. Every metric carries denominator + population ID. Consolidate: market.summarize_taken + clv_scale guard; prob_calibration taken-wrapper; single quant_block; policy_sim.apply_config + lcb/cell/white; mandate artifact header {generated_utc, model_hash, policy_hash, panel_max_gd, population_id, denominator, clock_mix, fills}.
eval_sim_specs.simulator: Canonical sim service calling live selection/devig/dedup/settle/grade. Modes: historical-live-replay, policy-replay, model-replay, execution-sim (quotes/slippage/limits/missing), bankroll-risk (sequential, correlated — separate), shadow-forward. Run manifest: run ID, code state (no git ops), config hash, model/cal/policy/feature versions, checksums, cutoffs, range, seed, funnel, assumptions, outputs. PIT rules: decision-time quotes only; explicit unavailable/no-fill/void states; deterministic IDs/seeds; reconcile vs live overlap.
